svg.title: ReWatch(Iot) hardware and data-flow architecture
svg.desc: Horizontal left-to-right pipeline: network switch feeds the Sentinel Raspberry Pi 3 B+ sniffer, which forwards alerts to the Core Raspberry Pi 4 that evaluates rules and pushes them to the Herald Pi 3, which delivers email via SMTP. Below, a laptop shows the HTTP dashboard with acknowledgements returning to the Core, and a tamper-evident enclosure holds an ESP32-WROOM-32 room rig (OLED and pixel status, USB Wi-Fi antenna) plus an ESP32-C3 environmental monitor. All illustration; not photographs.
svg.text: IoT intrusion detection — live hardware data flow (left → right)
browser: events · ack button · LED states
12 V LED strip · no mains wiring
Vector illustration for documentation — not photographs. Black Hat WROOM rig models rooms in software (no mains wiring); ESP32-C3 is serial by default with optional MQTT; SMTP accepted ≠ delivery.
